# A1 Transmission

A1 Transmission is an independent family auto repair shop at 20146 Saticoy Street B1, Winnetka, CA 91306. The shop opened in April 1995 and serves Winnetka, Canoga Park, and the San Fernando Valley. California Bureau of Automotive Repair License: ARD 194825. Phone: (818) 882-5135. Email: service@a1transmissionautos.com. Hours: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–6:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM–12:00 PM, Sunday closed.

Transmission diagnosis is free unless the transmission must be removed and opened. If the transmission has to be removed and opened, that is not free. After diagnosis the shop gives a written explanation. Rebuild versus replace depends on how badly the transmission is damaged. Cost depends on the vehicle and what the diagnosis finds. Call (818) 882-5135 for a free diagnosis and a written estimate before any work starts. A rebuild usually takes 2 days or more. The shop offers a 1-year / 12,000-mile warranty on parts and labor (whichever comes first).

The shop works on almost all makes and models. CVTs are usually replaced rather than rebuilt. Common warning signs are not shifting, slipping in certain gears, and noises. Towing is usually paid by the customer. There is no in-house financing, but the shop can refer customers to a financing company.

The only shop is in Winnetka. Winnetka borders Canoga Park. Canoga Park is a service area, not a second storefront. Google review replies are signed Young.

## Services

- Automatic and manual transmission rebuild and repair
- Free transmission diagnosis, unless the transmission must be removed and opened
- Transmission full fluid flush
- Clutch service and repair
- Brake repair and brake system fluid service
- Axle differential repair and drive shaft replacement
- Transfer case and 4x4 repair
